content.user_title: Create Verified Obsidian Web Clipper Templates
content.value_statement: Building reliable Web Clipper templates requires matching page data to Obsidian fields. This skill verifies variables and selectors, then produces importable template JSON.
actual_capabilities: Creates importable Obsidian Web Clipper template structures.
Maps Obsidian Base properties to Clipper frontmatter fields.
Identifies preset, metadata, Schema.org, and CSS selector variables.
Applies documented filters, fallbacks, conditionals, loops, and variable assignment.
Verifies selectors against a supplied page or browser DOM snapshot.
limitations: Requires a representative URL or DOM snapshot for selector verification.
Cannot verify selectors when the target content is inaccessible or absent.
Depends on current Obsidian Web Clipper syntax and editor validation.
Does not import templates into Obsidian or test them inside the extension.

use_cases.title: Capture Research Articles
use_cases.description: Create a template that saves article content, source details, publication dates, and authors into consistent research notes.

use_cases.title: Align Clips With Bases
use_cases.description: Map existing Base properties into matching Web Clipper fields for consistent vault metadata.

use_cases.title: Extract Structured Recipes
use_cases.description: Verify Recipe schema fields and format ingredients, instructions, images, and nutrition data for clipping.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Article Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a general Obsidian Web Clipper template for articles. Include title, author, URL, publication date, description, and content fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with common article fields and no custom selectors.

prompt_templates.title: Map an Obsidian Base
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Clippings Base properties and create a matching Web Clipper template. Ask which fields should be automatic, fixed, or manual.
prompt_templates.scenario: Match an existing vault schema before creating the template.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Site Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this public sample URL: [URL]. Verify Schema.org data, metadata, and selectors before creating a recipe template for my Recipes Base.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a site-specific template from verified page data.

prompt_templates.title: Design Advanced Template Logic
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a template for [content type] from [URL]. Add verified fallbacks, conditionals, and loops while preserving valid Clipper syntax.
prompt_templates.scenario: Handle optional fields and repeated structured data.

output_examples.input: Create a general article clipping template with standard metadata.
output_examples.output: An importable template using title, author, source, publication date, description, content, and a Clippings folder path.

output_examples.input: Build a recipe template from a page containing Recipe schema data.
output: A Recipe trigger selects the template.
Verified schema fields populate ingredients, instructions, author, image, and nutrition sections.
The note is saved in the Recipes folder.

output_examples.input: Match a clipping template to an existing Obsidian Base.
output_examples.output: A property mapping identifies automatic, fixed, and manual values before presenting the final importable template.

best_practices: Provide a representative public URL and the relevant Base properties.
Prefer Schema.org data and metadata before using fragile CSS selectors.
Validate the generated template in the Obsidian Web Clipper editor.
anti_patterns: Do not guess selectors when the page or target element is unavailable.
Do not add template logic when simple variables provide the same result.
Do not assume every Base property should be filled automatically.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates importable JSON templates for the Obsidian Web Clipper.

faq.question: Does it support Obsidian Bases?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps Base property names to matching Clipper template properties.

faq.question: Why is a sample URL needed?
faq.answer: A representative page lets the skill verify metadata, structured data, and selectors before generating the template.

faq.question: Can it create templates without a URL?
faq.answer: Yes, for general templates using preset variables. Site-specific selectors cannot be verified without page content.

faq.question: Does it support conditional sections and loops?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents fallbacks, conditionals, loops, and variable assignment supported by Web Clipper.

faq.question: Will it install the template automatically?
faq.answer: No. It produces template content that the user must import and validate in Obsidian Web Clipper.
